## Change-window preflight

Run this immediately before a fleet rollout. It returns **GO**, **GO WITH CAUTION**, or **NO-GO** from the current SOC snapshot and newest Hydra production evaluation, then posts the signed-off checklist to Discord.

NO-GO includes unavailable hosts/services, failed units, stale backups, deployment failures/drift, dangerously full disks, urgent certificate renewal, OpenCanary activity, or incomplete/failed Hydra production jobs. This workflow observes only; it cannot deploy or remediate anything.
